استعصي (form X)
# اُسْتُعْصِيَ (ustuʕṣiya) /us.tuʕ.sˤi.ja/: third-person masculine singular past passive of اِسْتَعْصَى (istaʕṣā)
# اِسْتَعْصِي (istaʕṣī) /is.taʕ.sˤiː/: second-person feminine singular imperative of اِسْتَعْصَى (istaʕṣā)
